requirements.title: Gradle 8.14.3 wrapper as the only build tool
requirements.heading: docs/spec/02.build.srs.md:44
requirements.summary: The system shall be built only through the Gradle 8.14.3 wrapper, and the repository shall contain no Maven or other build tool files.

requirements.title: Module set and root project name
requirements.heading: docs/spec/02.build.srs.md:96
requirements.summary: The system shall, in the root `settings.gradle`, name the root project `NaruServe-build` and include `NaruServe-api`, `NaruServe-servlet` and one module each for the TinyHttpd `HttpAdapter`, the Gson `JsonCodec`, the default bootstrap backing `RestApp.create()`, the Kotlin extensions, the SLF4J `Logger` adapter, the rotating file `Logger` and the Logcat `Logger`.

requirements.title: Single root build file configures every module
requirements.heading: docs/spec/02.build.srs.md:151
requirements.summary: The system shall configure every module of the root build from the root `build.gradle`, with no per-module build file.

requirements.title: Java 8 bytecode target for Java and Kotlin compilation
requirements.heading: docs/spec/02.build.srs.md:205
requirements.summary: The system shall compile Java sources of every module with `options.release = 8` and Kotlin sources of every module and test source set with `jvmTarget = 1.8`.

requirements.title: Maven group and Java package root
requirements.heading: docs/spec/02.build.srs.md:260
requirements.summary: The system shall use one Maven group and one Java package root, fixed in issue #1 as `com.snoworca.naruserve`, for every module.

requirements.title: Main dependencies of every module declared in wave 1
requirements.heading: docs/spec/02.build.srs.md:312
requirements.summary: The system shall declare in wave 1 the complete main and compileOnly dependency set of every module, so later waves add only test-scope dependencies or the release plugins owned by issue #18.

requirements.title: kotlin-stdlib confined to the Kotlin extension module
requirements.heading: docs/spec/02.build.srs.md:376
requirements.summary: The system shall keep `kotlin-stdlib` off the main configurations of every module except the Kotlin extension module, and shall fail the build when any other module has `kotlin-stdlib` on its `runtimeClasspath`.

requirements.title: Logcat Logger module builds without an Android SDK
requirements.heading: docs/spec/02.build.srs.md:432
requirements.summary: The system shall build the Logcat `Logger` module with no compile-time Android dependency, reaching `android.util.Log` only through reflection at runtime.

requirements.title: TinyHttpd dependency boundaries
requirements.heading: docs/spec/02.build.srs.md:540
requirements.summary: The system shall reference TinyHttpd only from the TinyHttpd adapter module, only through the Maven coordinates `com.snoworca.tinyhttpd:tinyhttpd-core` and `com.snoworca.tinyhttpd:tinyhttpd-websocket`, and only in `implementation` scope.

requirements.title: TinyHttpd checkout stays read-only
requirements.heading: docs/spec/02.build.srs.md:597
requirements.summary: The system shall leave every file inside the TinyHttpd checkout unmodified in every wave of the run, and shall record a TinyHttpd gap that the NaruServe adapter cannot fill as a deferred issue.

requirements.title: compileOnly nullability annotations recognised by Kotlin
requirements.heading: docs/spec/02.build.srs.md:708
requirements.summary: The system shall add in wave 1 one nullability annotation library that the Kotlin compiler recognises, declared in `compileOnly` scope with no runtime dependency.

requirements.title: animal-sniffer API 21 check on Android-bound modules
requirements.heading: docs/spec/02.build.srs.md:762
requirements.summary: The system shall run animal-sniffer with the `android-api-level-21` signature on the main source set of every Android-bound module as part of `check`, and shall not apply it to `NaruServe-servlet`.

requirements.title: Core isolation, servlet-free Android modules and single Gson version build checks
requirements.heading: docs/spec/02.build.srs.md:816
requirements.summary: The system shall fail the build when `NaruServe-api` main classes reference a forbidden package, when main classes of an Android-targeted module reference `javax.servlet`, and when dependency resolution of any module selects a Gson version other than 2.14.0.

requirements.title: TinyHttpd composite build through a Gradle property
requirements.heading: docs/spec/02.build.srs.md:485
requirements.summary: The system shall include TinyHttpd into the build with `includeBuild`, reading the checkout directory from a Gradle property whose default is `/Users/beom/work/git/TinyHttpd`, and shall fail while Gradle evaluates `settings.gradle` when that directory is missing.

requirements.title: Test tooling and the root build gate
requirements.heading: docs/spec/02.build.srs.md:651
requirements.summary: The system shall run JUnit 4.13.2 Java tests and Kotlin tests compiled by Kotlin Gradle Plugin 2.x inside the root `./gradlew build`, including one Java and one Kotlin smoke test, and the build shall pass on JDK 17 without an Android SDK.

requirements.title: Module names and coordinates in docs/api and CLAUDE.md
requirements.heading: docs/spec/02.build.srs.md:872
requirements.summary: The system shall name, in `docs/api/` and `CLAUDE.md`, the final module names, dependency coordinates, API 21 check targets and the TinyHttpd commit fixed in issue #1.
